key: ADRIENN: El and Gardevoir have continued up to the aerie.
en: ADRIENN: El and Gardevoir have continued up to the aerie.
ja: アドリエンヌ: エルとサーナイトは、ワシの巣まで進んでいったわ。

key: He asked to take the Ruby Ring from you so that you can't follow us.
en: He asked to take the Ruby Ring from you so that you can't follow us.
ja: あなたたちが追いかけてこられないように、あなたからルビーのゆびわを取ってきてほしいって、頼まれたの。

key: Will you give it to me?
en: Will you give it to me?
ja: それをくれる?

key: CAIN: Whoa, what are you saying, \PN?
en: CAIN: Whoa, what are you saying, \PN?
ja: カイン: おい、何言ってんだ、\PN?

key: That belongs to Heather.
en: That belongs to Heather.
ja: それはヘザーのものだ。

key: You can't just give it away!
en: You can't just give it away!
ja: ただでやるわけにはいかない!

key: CAIN: That's right!
en: CAIN: That's right!
ja: カイン: その通り!

key: No way you're getting that ring!
en: No way you're getting that ring!
ja: その指輪を渡すわけにはいかない!

key: ADRIENN: Yes, you said something like that about the Amethyst Pendant, too.
en: ADRIENN: Yes, you said something like that about the Amethyst Pendant, too.
ja: アドリエンヌ: ええ、アメジストのペンダントについても、同じようなこと言ってたわね。

key: It really doesn't seem like you're lying.
en: It really doesn't seem like you're lying.
ja: うそをついてるようには、本当に見えないわ。

key: But El insists that they belong to him.
en: But El insists that they belong to him.
ja: でも、エルはそれが自分のものだと言い張ってる。

key: And he did seem to know about them.
en: And he did seem to know about them.
ja: それに、彼はそれについて何か知ってるようだった。

key: RADOMUS: These are old artifacts.
en: RADOMUS: These are old artifacts.
ja: ラドマス: これらは古い遺物だ。

key: It is not a simple matter of a single owner knowing their worth, or I'm sure several conflicts would have been solved already.
en: It is not a simple matter of a single owner knowing their worth, or I'm sure several conflicts would have been solved already.
ja: 単純にひとりの持ち主がその価値を知っている、という問題ではあるまい。そうでなければ、すでにいくつもの争いが解決していたはずだ。

key: ADRIENN: I believe that.
en: ADRIENN: I believe that.
ja: アドリエンヌ: それは信じるわ。

key: It's plain that they hold power.
en: It's plain that they hold power.
ja: それらが力を持っているのは、明らかだから。

key: I had been wandering around down here for nearly an hour, yet I couldn't manage to open the doors at all without them.
en: I had been wandering around down here for nearly an hour, yet I couldn't manage to open the doors at all without them.
ja: わたしはここで一時間近くさまよってたけど、あれがなければ、ドアはまったく開けられなかった。

key: Just what is this place?
en: Just what is this place?
ja: ここは一体、何なのかしら?

key: RADOMUS: I believe that that answer will become clear as we press forward.
en: RADOMUS: I believe that that answer will become clear as we press forward.
ja: ラドマス: その答えは、先へ進むにつれて明らかになるはずだ。

key: ADRIENN: Which brings us back to the ring, huh?
en: ADRIENN: Which brings us back to the ring, huh?
ja: アドリエンヌ: それで、話は指輪に戻るわけね?

key: One of you is definitely lying to me.
en: One of you is definitely lying to me.
ja: あなたたちのうち誰かが、絶対にわたしにうそをついてる。

key: But who?
en: But who?
ja: でも、誰?

key: CAIN: I dunno what's up with Gardevoir, but El kidnapped her from Radomus.
en: CAIN: I dunno what's up with Gardevoir, but El kidnapped her from Radomus.
ja: カイン: サーナイトのことはよくわかんねえけど、エルがラドマスから彼女をさらったんだ。

key: Luna wants us to get her back!
en: Luna wants us to get her back!
ja: ルナは、彼女を取り戻してほしがってる!

key: ADRIENN: Yes, that Luna girl he keeps mentioning.
en: ADRIENN: Yes, that Luna girl he keeps mentioning.
ja: アドリエンヌ: ああ、彼が何度も言ってたルナって子ね。

key: Surely there's some way to prove one way or another?
en: Surely there's some way to prove one way or another?
ja: どちらが本当か、証明する方法があるはずよね?

key: RADOMUS: Elementary, my dear Adrienn.
en: RADOMUS: Elementary, my dear Adrienn.
ja: ラドマス: 簡単なことだよ、親愛なるアドリエンヌ。

key: Allow me.
en: Allow me.
ja: 任せてくれ。

key: RADOMUS: This is the ransom note left for me by El.
en: RADOMUS: This is the ransom note left for me by El.
ja: ラドマス: これが、エルが私に残していった身代金要求の手紙だ。

key: Please, read it.
en: Please, read it.
ja: どうか、読んでみてくれ。

key: The others can attest to the fact that it is not a forgery.
en: The others can attest to the fact that it is not a forgery.
ja: 他の者たちが、これが偽物ではないと証言できる。

key: ADRIENN: "To one Radomus Vanhanen... I have captured your precious 'Gossip Gardevoir'.
en: ADRIENN: "To one Radomus Vanhanen... I have captured your precious 'Gossip Gardevoir'.
ja: アドリエンヌ: 「ラドマス・ヴァンハネン殿へ……あなたの大切な『ゴシップ・サーナイト』を捕らえた。

key: Should you wish to see her again, you will return my daughter to me immediately. -El"
en: Should you wish to see her again, you will return my daughter to me immediately. -El"
ja: 再び会いたければ、直ちに私の娘を返してもらおう。―エル」

key: RADOMUS: If I were really so bad of a Trainer as to warrant the hate that Gardevoir confesses, would I have followed El here?
en: RADOMUS: If I were really so bad of a Trainer as to warrant the hate that Gardevoir confesses, would I have followed El here?
ja: ラドマス: サーナイトが打ち明けたような憎しみを買うほど、私が本当にひどいトレーナーなら、こうしてエルについてここまで来ただろうか?

key: CAIN: I'm not gonna lie-- you didn't seem too happy to go at first.
en: CAIN: I'm not gonna lie-- you didn't seem too happy to go at first.
ja: カイン: 正直、最初はあんまり気乗りしてなさそうだったけどな。

key: RADOMUS: Yet here I am.
en: RADOMUS: Yet here I am.
ja: ラドマス: それでも、私はここにいる。

key: ADRIENN: None of this makes any sense.
en: ADRIENN: None of this makes any sense.
ja: アドリエンヌ: 何もかも、筋が通らないわね。

key: CAIN: Right? But we're gonna get to the bottom of it!
en: CAIN: Right? But we're gonna get to the bottom of it!
ja: カイン: だろ? でも、真相を突き止めてやるぜ!

key: Or the top, since we seem to be going up, but...
en: Or the top, since we seem to be going up, but...
ja: てか、上に向かってるみたいだから、「真相の頂上」か……

key: Well, bottom, top, whatever.
en: Well, bottom, top, whatever.
ja: まあ、底でも頂上でも、どっちでもいいけど。

key: I'm a switch; I don't care~
en: I'm a switch; I don't care~
ja: オレはどっちもいけるタイプだからな、気にしない~

key: RADOMUS: Again, I'm going to pretend that I didn't catch that.
en: RADOMUS: Again, I'm going to pretend that I didn't catch that.
ja: ラドマス: また、今のは聞こえなかったことにしよう。

key: ADRIENN: All right, let's go find out together.
en: ADRIENN: All right, let's go find out together.
ja: アドリエンヌ: よし、一緒に確かめに行きましょう。

key: All of us. Through the Ruby Door, then.
en: All of us. Through the Ruby Door, then.
ja: みんなで。それじゃ、ルビーの扉から。

key: ADRIENN: \PN, would you do the honors as the ring- bearer?
en: ADRIENN: \PN, would you do the honors as the ring- bearer?
ja: アドリエンヌ: \PN、指輪の運び手として、開けてもらえる?

key: CAIN: Maaan, this is a mess.
en: CAIN: Maaan, this is a mess.
ja: カイン: いやー、めちゃくちゃだな。

key: It sounds like Adrienn's as confused as we are.
en: It sounds like Adrienn's as confused as we are.
ja: アドリエンヌも、オレたちと同じくらい混乱してるみたいだし。

key: I'm really not sure if we can trust Radomus, but El is also suspicious.
en: I'm really not sure if we can trust Radomus, but El is also suspicious.
ja: ラドマスを信用していいのか正直わかんねえけど、エルも怪しいしな。

key: RADOMUS: Is it only obvious to me?
en: RADOMUS: Is it only obvious to me?
ja: ラドマス: それは、私にだけ明らかなことなのかね?

key: Well, I suppose that would make sense.
en: Well, I suppose that would make sense.
ja: まあ、それも道理か。

key: ADRIENN: By the by, I prefer xe/xem/xyr or they/them pronouns.
en: ADRIENN: By the by, I prefer xe/xem/xyr or they/them pronouns.
ja: アドリエンヌ: ところで、わたしは「彼/彼女」ではなく、それ以外の呼び方の方が好きなの。

key: I assume something similar for yourself?
en: I assume something similar for yourself?
ja: あなたも、似たような感じかしら?

key: To be honest, it's sort of nice to meet someone else like me.
en: To be honest, it's sort of nice to meet someone else like me.
ja: 正直、自分と似た誰かに会えるのは、ちょっとうれしいものね。

key: I haven't exactly met many people who understand firsthand.
en: I haven't exactly met many people who understand firsthand.
ja: 実体験として理解してくれる人には、あまり会ったことがなくて。

key: Sure, sympathy is nice and all, but it's sort of that in- one-ear-and-out-the-other syndrome.
en: Sure, sympathy is nice and all, but it's sort of that in- one-ear-and-out-the-other syndrome.
ja: 同情はもちろんありがたいけど、なんというか、右から左に抜けていく感じのものだから。

key: You probably know how it goes.
en: You probably know how it goes.
ja: あなたも、たぶんわかると思うけど。

key: You know how there are genderless Pokémon, right?
en: You know how there are genderless Pokémon, right?
ja: 性別のないポケモンがいるの、知ってるでしょ?

key: Like that, I prefer to think of myself as not being on either side.
en: Like that, I prefer to think of myself as not being on either side.
ja: それと同じで、わたしは自分を、どちらの側でもないと考えるようにしているの。

key: Yes
en: Yes
ja: はい

key: No
en: No
ja: いいえ
